name: Mize
description: Logs every job application and shows which employers actually reply.
notes: Delete a job, shift or saved search on one device and it stays deleted everywhere, instead of coming back from another computer or your phone
Your record syncs by itself each time you come back to the window, so a change made on your phone shows without pressing Sync
Hourly rates read as whole pounds when there are no pence, so a job pays £12/hr rather than £12.00/hr
